what: Hook blocking balance framework determined from validation: (1) Read/Edit: block first encounter only, soft on retry — prevents infinite blocking while preserving first prompt. Session F proved soft is ~90% effective. (2) Stop: extend dynamic to 3→5→10 — phase 1 (turns 1-9) every 3, phase 2 (10-29) every 5, phase 3 (30+) every 10. Long sessions get progressively quieter. (3) Search: always soft (validated). (4) Balance principle: block for first encounters and periodic checkpoints, soft for discovery, silent for routine. (5) Rules file (.claude/rules/aide-memory.md) is always in context, loaded at session start, survives compaction — but compliance is low without hook prompting.
why: User wants to determine best defaults from validation data before making hooks configurable. This framework balances friction vs recall/remember coverage.
